desc: Derive and implement the parity-DSU reduction, including all row/column parity checks and B-cell equations.
Prove that each consistent DSU assignment corresponds bijectively to one tile placement.
Handle toroidal wraparound and count free components modulo 998244353.
Validate the algorithm against the three samples and brute-force small grids.
Produce the final Python solution with linear time and memory in total grid size.
